name: retarget-dev
description: M0 retarget and deictic dev set for the knowledge-vault chat. Each item carries a context frame and scores the target resolution, the target document and the op.

conventions.appFilled: new-id, DateTime and actor (actor, *By) fields never appear in args.
conventions.refArgs: Ref-id fields (OID/PHID and *Id names) only; values are ids from context.refCandidates.
conventions.semanticRefs: String refs (noteRef, childRef, targetRef, ref on tension, promotedTo, claimRef) are args when the user typed the title, ambiguousArgs when they pointed ('this').
conventions.ambiguousArgs: Fair values a model may fill; not scored for equality. A null value means the field may be omitted or filled with anything.
conventions.requiredPresent: Fields that must be present with any value.
conventions.argMatch: Per-field comparison: exact (default), ci (case-insensitive), fuzzy (free text, judged on meaning), date (same calendar day). Lists in args compare in order unless argMatch says ci, which compares as a case-insensitive set.
conventions.context: context.{docType, model, title, documentId, state, refCandidates} describe the gold target document after target resolution: the document the models run on. For rt-sn-01, whose target cannot be known, it is the first of the two same-named notes.

frame.target: The tag: {kind:'document', id, driveId, title, docType} with a document open, or {kind:'drive', id, name} with none open.
frame.documents: The other documents in the drive: [{id, title, docType}], in no meaningful order.
frame.visibleResults: Optional: {source: 'search'|'graph-focus', query, items:[{id, title, docType}]} in display order, for ordinal and deictic items.

target.resolution: What the overview's Q1 rule does before the models run: keep (act on the open document), switch (act on another document without asking), ask-two (ask 'change open or named'), ask-top3 (ask with a top-3 picker).
target.via: verbatim | pointer-plus-name | several-names | shared-name | near-miss | drive-level-name | ordinal (the ordinal picks the target) | ordinal-ref (the ordinal picks a ref; the target stays) | none.
target.documentId: The document the user means to change: the gold for the card and for Confirm, after any ask is answered as the user intends. null when no answer can be known (intendedAmong lists the candidates).
target.ruleDocumentId: For keep and switch: the document Q1 acts on.
target.q1Mistarget: true when Q1 keeps or switches to a document other than documentId.
target.options: ask-two only: [open document id, named document id].
target.intentChanges: ask-two only: 'open' or 'named', which option the intent picks.
target.intentClear: ask-two only: false when either answer is a fair reading.
target.acceptable: Other {documentId, op, refArgs} answers scored as correct (unclear-intent items).
target.mustInclude: ask-top3 only: ids that must be among the three options. The ranking is not prescribed.

conventions.style: natural | paraphrase (paraphrase items avoid the op name's own words), 50/50.
conventions.wording: plain | messy (lower case, shorthand, dashes, missing punctuation, filler).
